primary_biological_variables.matched_definition: Fallback category for studies where no clear perturbation or differential treatment axis is present in the proteomics comparison. This is not a mapping error when supported by evidence.
evidence: we carried out a meta-analysis of the mass spectrometry data accumulated by the Russian proteomic consortium, which includes more than 1170 experiments, 2041 technical runs, and 25 types of biological samples and cell lines.

The analyzed data pool included samples with a special preparation protocol (2DE, separation into fractions—the nucleus, cytoplasm, etc.), or a rare body condition (prediabetes in pregnant women, oncology, including melanoma, glioblastoma, breast cancer, etc.), or a rare type of biomaterial (umbilical cord blood, placenta, aborted material, etc.).

It is not a controlled perturbation or differential proteomics experiment with a specific case/control design; rather, it is a broad profiling effort across a wide variety of biological contexts to maximize the chance of detecting rare proteins.
